canonicalization:
Collapse a listing path to its motion identity.

Starts from variant_stem() and additionally strips every trailing variant suffix
(see VARIANT_SUFFIX) iteratively, so mirrored/rotated/directional takes of the same
motion collapse together.
category_split: G1 only trains on 'simple' (locomotion/control) categories, split randomly 85/15 (train/valid). Every 'complex' category motion is held out from G1 training entirely (human2robot). SOMA trains on everything, split randomly 85/15 independent of category and of G1's split -- see soma_split.

semantics.valid: G1: simple-category motion, held out (random 15%, standard holdout)
semantics.human2robot: G1: complex-category motion, never trained (human -> humanoid transfer test); SOMA trains/valids it via its own independent split
